items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: I had the Dr. Lernard, who was the director of the school, I went back and told him... Dr. Lernard set up an appointment and we discussed it and everything.

ctx.x: Yeah. You see but I was part of the integration in Hollywood, see? Because I had finished school at the Westlake College of Music in Hollywood for film scoring and radio and T.V. and all of that, after I had finished the New York Conservatory of Modern Music in Brooklyn you see. And it was in that particular sojourn, and going to Hollywood for that, it’s where I also challenged the Local 47, the white local, why they refused my card. I said well why can’t I, as a transfer person, transfer it, and also become a…
